name: tabbywebrtc
description: Remote desktop streaming with a browser-based viewer and mobile auth key

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,server,agent -c blue,green,magenta "yarn dev:frontend" "yarn dev:server" "yarn dev:agent"
scripts.build: yarn build:frontend && yarn build:infra && yarn build:agent
scripts.test: yarn test:infra && yarn test:agent && yarn test:frontend && yarn test:testServer
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace frontend typecheck && yarn workspace infra build
scripts.cdk:synth: yarn workspace infra cdk synth --context env=dev
scripts.cdk:synth:prod: yarn workspace infra cdk synth --context env=prod
